contexts.text: The land did not bear them to dwell together () = that those things which belong to inward celestial things could not be with those... which are here signified by Lot.
Under Bear, see this reference. AC 9737.
Man takes with him into the other life the interior things of the Natural...
Carry your father, and come () = their service and approach. Explained.

And he saw the waggons which Joseph had sent to carry him () = doctrinal things therefrom which exercised persuasion... To carry him = the things which exercised persuasion; for to carry him to Joseph, to see him, is to persuade.

And the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father () = that truths which are spiritual made natural truth advance... The reason they carried = that they made advance, is that it is predicated of spiritual truths relatively to natural truth...
Thou shalt carry me out of Egypt () = that there may be elevation from knowledges. To carry me = elevation, because going from Egypt to Canaan is called going up.
And his sons carried him into the Land of Canaan () = that the Church was transferred thither. They carried = to be transferred.
Man... is borne upwards and downwards... But they who suffer themselves to be regenerated are borne continually upwards...
That man takes with him into the other life whatever he has known, nay, whatever he has seen, heard, thought, spoken, willed, and done, in the world, References. AC 9333:3.
I have borne you on eagles' wings () = that thus they have been elevated to heavenly light through truths... To bear = to be elevated.
Thou shalt not take the name of thy God in vain = profanations and revilings of the truth and good of faith.
Thou shalt not bear a report of vanity () = no hearkening to falsities. To bear a report = to hear and do, thus to hearken.

He will not bear your transgression () = that these things are repugnant to truths from good... Not to bear your transgression = not to endure falsities from evil, because they are repugnant to truths from good.
To bear, or carry upon the two shoulders () = the Divine preservation of good and truth. See AC 9836:end.

Bearing iniquity, transgression, and sin () = the removing of evil, and of the falsity thereof, so that they do not appear. To bear, or take away = to remove a thing so that it does not appear. Explained.
Wherefore a Spirit is borne, as it were of himself, to those who are like himself...
The understanding (differently from the will) is carried, now upwards, now downwards...
Thou canst not bear the evil () = that they cannot endure that evils should be called goods, and contrariwise, because to do so is contrary to the truths of doctrine.
Thou canst not bear the evil = that they reject evils. Not to be able to bear = to reject, for what a man cannot bear, he rejects.
To bear as with eagles' wings, and bring () = into intelligence, because into Heaven and its light.
To bear a blessing () = the reception of Divine Truth; and to bear righteousness, the reception of Divine Good.
To yield fruit of increase () = to do (spiritual truths) and receive goods.
